card.name: Hepatitis C antiviral drug context
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small linking words right after hepatitis C antiviral phrases, such as a colon after 'Hepatitis C direct acting antiviral' or 'with' after 'HCV treatment'. It comes just before a named HCV drug like sofosbuvir or ledipasvir.

modes.label: Colon after HCV drug class
modes.description: A colon ends a hepatitis C antiviral class heading in an interaction list, just before the drug names.
modes.example: Hepatitis C direct acting antiviral<<:>> el

modes.label: Linking word before HCV drug
modes.description: A small word like 'with' or 'of' follows an HCV treatment phrase and leads into a named drug.
modes.example: before initiating HCV treatment<< with>> sofosbuvir and velp

modes.label: Spacing in citation lists
modes.description: A space inside a list of section numbers or after 'Table' in HCV labels.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to name a specific hepatitis C antiviral such as sofosbuvir, though the listed output tokens are not very informative.
card.plain: It fires on the small punctuation or linking word just before a hepatitis C antiviral drug name is given.
